app.descricao: Construction management app for builders, contractors, civil engineers and architects: stage-by-stage project schedule, daily reports (daily logs) with photos and PDF, project finances, crew and payroll, purchases and inventory, and a portal where the client follows the project. faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Does my client pay to follow the project?
faq.a1: No. Your client follows the project in the portal at no cost. If you want to share more, like downloading photos and seeing the full finances, Client Access is a one-time fee per project, paid by you on PRO.
faq.q2: Can I use it on my computer and my phone?
faq.a2: Yes. ObraFácil works on Android, iPhone, Windows and in the browser, with the same data everywhere.
faq.a3: Data travels encrypted and is stored on Google’s servers, also encrypted. Each person only sees the projects they take part in, with the permissions of their role.
faq.q4: What personal data do you collect?
faq.a4: For the account: name, email address and phone number; a tax number only if you provide it. The full list, and what each piece of data is for, is in the Privacy Policy.
faq.a5: Yes. Without internet, the app keeps what you record on the device and sends it automatically when the connection returns.
faq.q6: Does the client lose access to the files when the project ends?
faq.a6: If the project is 70% complete or more when access ends, the client still has 15 days to view and download what was shared.
faq.q7: Does ObraFácil replace the project engineer?
faq.a7: No. It is a management tool and does not replace the qualified professional responsible for the works.
faq.a8: Yes, under Profile > Delete account. The account is suspended for 30 days (you can change your mind) and then your projects and data are deleted. Some records, such as payments and acceptance of the Terms, are kept for the period set out in the Privacy Policy.
faq.q9: Can I cancel PRO or the storage expansion?
faq.a9: Yes, at any time, in the same place you subscribed. The next renewal is not charged and access continues until the end of the paid period.
faq.q10: What if a renewal is not paid?
faq.a10: The account goes back to the free plan. Nothing is deleted; if you are over the free plan limit, only uploading new files is blocked until you free up space or subscribe again.

cliente.titulo: No more answering **“how is the project going?”**
cliente.texto: Your client gets an email invitation and follows the project in the Client Portal at no cost: photos, daily reports, schedule and a summary of the finances.
cliente.msg1: Hi! How is the project going? Any photos from today?
cliente.msg2: Will the floors be done by next Friday?
cliente.msg3: Hi. I’ll ask the foreman to send some.
pontos: Your client signs in with their own account, from the invitation you send.
Want to share more? With Client Access (on PRO, a one-time fee per project), you choose what they can see and download: photos, full finances, the detailed schedule and opening issues.
On projects 70% complete or more, when access ends the client still has 15 days to download what was shared.

pagamento.metaDescricao: Your payment went through. See when your purchase shows up in ObraFácil and what to do if it takes a while.
pagamento.voltarTexto: Go back to the browser tab or the Windows app where you made the purchase. If you already closed it, open ObraFácil again with the same account.
pagamento.automaticoTexto: Stripe, which processes the payment, notifies our server, and your purchase is unlocked on your account within moments. You don't need to do anything.
pagamento.demoraTitulo: If it hasn't shown up yet
pagamento.demoraEsperar: Wait a minute, then close and reopen the app. In your browser, reload the ObraFácil page.
pagamento.demoraSairEntrar: Still on the free plan? Sign out and sign in again with the same email you used to pay: when you sign in, the app looks for the website subscription and turns PRO on.
pagamento.demoraRestaurar: **Restore purchases** won't help here: it only finds purchases made in your phone's app store (Google Play or App Store).
pagamento.demoraSuporte: If nothing works, contact support and include the email you used to pay.

geral.texto: Your payment went through. Within moments ObraFácil receives the confirmation and unlocks what you bought.
geral.conferir: Open ObraFácil with the same account you used to buy: your purchase shows up by itself.
geral.artigo: Where to see your payment history

pro.texto: Your subscription is confirmed. Within moments PRO turns on by itself on your account, on your phone, computer and browser.
pro.conferir: Open **Profile**: the badge on the top card changes to **PRO member** and the **Your plan** card shows **ObraFácil PRO**.
pro.artigo: I bought PRO on the website: how to activate it

acesso.texto: The project fee is paid. Within moments the app unlocks the paid Client Portal features for this project's client.
acesso.conferir: Open the project: at the bottom of the **PROJECT MENU**, the **Client Access** card shows **Access Granted**. Tap **CONFIGURE** and choose what the client can see and download.

downloads.texto: Within moments the project gets 2 more full downloads of the gallery ZIP, shared by all guests.
downloads.conferir: Go back to the **Project Gallery** and tap **Download All** again.
downloads.artigo: How to buy extra gallery downloads

armazenamento.texto: Your storage expansion is confirmed. Within moments the app adds 20 GB to your plan's space.
armazenamento.conferir: Open **Profile**: below the **Storage** bar, the **Your plan** card shows **+20 GB expansion active**.
armazenamento.artigo: How to add 20 GB of storage

perfil.metaDescricao: See where to find your plan, payment card and subscription cancellation in ObraFácil.
perfil.titulo: Your subscription lives in the app's **Profile**
perfil.texto: Your plan, charges, card and cancellation are in the app: in Profile, on the Your plan card. Open ObraFácil with your account and follow the steps below.
perfil.passo1Texto: On your phone, in the Windows app or in your browser, sign in with your account.
perfil.passo2Texto: On a phone, tap the menu (three lines) at the top of the dashboard, then your card, with your photo and name. On a computer, tap your card in the side bar.
perfil.passo3Texto: Right below your photo, the **Your plan** card shows your plan, storage used, projects and reports this month. With a subscription, tap **Manage**.
perfil.gerenciarCelular: **Subscribed on your phone**: the Google Play or App Store subscriptions area, with renewal, charges and cancellation.
perfil.gerenciarSite: **Subscribed on the website or a computer**: the payments page in your browser, to change your card, see charges or cancel.
perfil.gerenciarLugar: Canceling in one place doesn't cancel a subscription made in the other.
perfil.avisoTitulo: Got a payment not processed notice?
perfil.avisoTexto: Your bank declined the subscription charge. Tap **Manage** and add a valid card to keep PRO. If you've already paid, you can ignore the notice.
perfil.artigoCancelar: How to manage or cancel your subscription

suporte.metaDescricao: Contact ObraFácil support on WhatsApp, by email or with a ticket in the app, and see step-by-step guides in the Help Center.
suporte.texto: Ask a question, report a problem in the app or get help with charges. Average response time is 24 to 48 business hours.
suporte.whatsappMensagem: Hello, I came from the support page on your website and need help with ObraFácil.
suporte.emailTexto: To send details, screenshots and attachments. If you can, write from your account's email.
suporte.chamadoTexto: It stays on your account and is the way to request a refund for website purchases, under **Financial Help**. The reply goes to your account email.
suporte.centralTexto: Step-by-step guides for every screen in the app, with real screenshots.
suporte.lojasTitulo: Bought on Google Play or the App Store?
suporte.lojasTexto: Charges and refunds for those purchases are handled by the store itself, under its rules. To cancel, use **Manage** on the **Your plan** card in Profile.
